query:
SELECT s.tags AS "tags!",
               AVG(s.avg_viewers)::float8 AS avg_viewers,
               COUNT(DISTINCT s.streamer_login)::bigint AS "streamer_count!"
        FROM twitch_stream_sessions s
        WHERE s.started_at >= $1
          AND s.tags IS NOT NULL
          AND s.tags != ''
        GROUP BY s.tags
        HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3
        ORDER BY 2 DESC
        LIMIT 15
